name: Ferrun
title: Smith of the Starfall Forge
examine: Mountain-born, Balla's journeyman once. Wears a shard of his first masterwork on a cord: it cracked at the quench. He will not name a blade before the water.
lines: The delf's own mithril. The old realm swung this metal. Now you do.
A blade gets its name after the quench. Not before. Ask my necklace why.
Balla taught me the fire. The mountain taught me respect.
